interaction_motion.evidence: Verified from shots then CSS/JS. desktop_fold/form_end: nav CTA is square ghost (navy type, transparent fill); submit rest is matte navy. hover.png: header Request a quote fills solid navy/white type (LTR wipe). hover_submit.png: Send quote request goes #000 (user demand, waived). focus.png: same filled nav CTA as hover; crop too tight to see the 3px --action ring, but audit.json focus_invisible_count 0/25 and :focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--action);outline-offset:3px} plus white rings on footer/pagehead. Code: --t-feedback .15s, --t-ui .2s, --t-enter .65s, --ease cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1); overshoot_easing false; has_reduced_motion_rule true. Contact entrance is only .pagehead h1/.p pane 550ms/80ms stagger (transform+opacity), not per-section fade-up. Inputs hover border --blue; aria-invalid #a4260c; submit sets disabled+aria-busy+Sending…. Could not verify from frames: :active, loading, input focus, nav-link underline, or reduced-motion rendering.
strengths: Duration tokens and ease-out match DESIGN.md; button wipe is 200ms background-size, not layout; audit reports no overshoot easing.
One inner-page entrance (pagehead title/lead 550ms); sticky 2px --scrolled bar and header densify after 8px are informational, not card-lift decoration.
prefers-reduced-motion:reduce zeros animations/transitions and settles .pane/.pagehead; JS skips html.motion, --scrolled, IO, and smooth-scroll when reduce matches.

issues.problem: Clicking Send quote request (already wiped to #000 on hover) sets disabled, which forces background-size:0. The signature wipe animates backward over --t-ui 200ms while the label becomes Sending…, so the only async state on contact.html fights the hover the user just saw.
issues.fix: Keep the filled wipe during busy: .btn[disabled],.btn[aria-busy=true]{opacity:.7;cursor:wait;pointer-events:none;background-size:100% 100%;background-image:linear-gradient(#000,#000)}. Set min-width on .enquiry .btn to the rest label width so Sending… does not shrink the control.

issues.problem: filter:brightness(.92) on the demanded #000 wipe is not readable, so press has no distinct state after hover/focus-visible fill.
issues.fix: Replace brightness on .btn:active with transform:translateY(1px) (keep 150ms --t-feedback, --ease); do not use bounce/elastic.

issues.problem: Reduced-motion CSS sets transform:scaleX(0) and JS never writes --scrolled, so the 2px read-progress is hidden instead of snapping to current progress (the settled end state).
issues.fix: Delete .top::before{transform:scaleX(0)} from the reduce block; still set --scrolled in onScroll when reduce is true; leave transition:none so the bar jumps, not eases.

issues.problem: Pointer hover sets border-color:var(--blue); keyboard focus only uses the global outline, so the same fields do not share a focus chrome language. No input focus frame was in shots.
issues.fix: Add input:focus-visible,textarea:focus-visible{border-color:var(--blue)} beside the existing 3px outline; keep input[readonly] on --line with no hover wipe.
